subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in the place of the question mark '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

4 - 8 ÷ 12 + 16 × 2 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ced33fe5d53e6d48bd85aaf0ca9026f1470dad1a25506c6ecf4088c22d97c66.png] 

Given equation: 4 - 8 ÷ 12 + 16 × 2 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×’ and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 4 + 8 × 12 - 16 ÷
